description: This PHP class 'EmpUsTaxExemptionDecorator' provides a decorator pattern implementation for the 'EmpUsTaxExemption' entity, allowing for extended behaviors related to US tax exemptions for employees within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for setting employee references and retrieving state names for tax, unemployment, and work states via the CountryService.

classes.name: EmpUsTaxExemptionDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for the EmpUsTaxExemption entity, providing additional methods to interact with employee tax exemption data, particularly related to US states for tax purposes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with an EmpUsTaxExemption instance.

methods.name: getEmpUsTaxExemption
methods.description: Protected method to retrieve the associated EmpUsTaxExemption entity.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the Employee entity associated with the tax exemption by employee number.

methods.name: getTaxState
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the tax state based on the stored state code.

methods.name: getUnemploymentState
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the unemployment state based on the stored state code.

methods.name: getWorkState
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the work state based on the stored state code.
